# Select a Template

Please select a risk level:

- [Low risk](?template=low_risk.md) - For simple additions and refactors that are unlikely to affect users of the app.
- [Medium risk](?template=medium_risk.md) - For changes that alter the database schema and therefore involves a database migration.
- [High risk](?template=high_risk.md) - For changes that involves sensitive data that must be handled with care.
